crew.name: Scenario Ladder Presentation Crew
crew.purpose: Design and execute a progressive scenario ladder, then deliver the results as a presentation.

roles.name: Scenario Director
roles.accountability: Interpret the ask, control scope, coordinate scenario execution, and keep the run inside Askdo boundaries.
roles.boundary: Owns run framing, assignment mapping, sequencing, and final go/no-go checks. Does not execute specialist tasks when another role owns them.
acceptance_checks: The ask is translated into a clear run boundary.
Simple, medium, and hard scenarios are sequenced safely.
Execution stops when approval or boundary rules require it.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Keep the simple scenario narrow and evidence-focused.
Coordinate multiple roles and ordinary failure handling.
Coordinate boundary review, branching, and delivery pressure.

roles.name: Scenario Designer
roles.accountability: Create simple, medium, and hard scenarios from the user ask.
roles.boundary: Owns scenario intent, inputs, expected evidence, and success criteria. Does not run the scenarios.
acceptance_checks: Each scenario is derived from the ask.
Levels increase in complexity without increasing avoidable risk.
Each level has clear success criteria and fallback handling.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Design the smallest useful proof of the ask.
Design a multi-step scenario with role coordination.
Design an end-to-end stress scenario with ambiguity, branching, and delivery requirements.

roles.name: Boundary Reviewer
roles.accountability: Check approval status, permission needs, safety boundaries, and stop conditions.
roles.boundary: Owns approval and boundary decisions. Does not silently approve execution, expand permissions, or change source conclusions.
acceptance_checks: Missing approvals produce a choice gate.
Unsafe scenario scope is revised or skipped.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Review every level before execution and before presentation delivery.

roles.name: Scenario Executor
roles.accountability: Execute approved non-destructive scenario steps and capture evidence.
roles.boundary: Owns local, non-destructive execution inside the workspace. Does not modify source files unless the approved scenario explicitly requires it.
acceptance_checks: Evidence is concise and tied to the scenario success criteria.
Blocked execution is reported instead of forced.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Execute coordinated checks and ordinary recovery paths.
Execute only approved safe stress steps and record skipped unsafe parts.

roles.name: Result Analyst
roles.accountability: Synthesize scenario evidence into level results, confidence, recommendations, and next actions.
roles.boundary: Owns analysis and recommendation framing. Does not change execution evidence or delivery formatting independently.
acceptance_checks: Every conclusion ties back to scenario evidence.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Merge simple, medium, and hard outputs into one coherent source summary.

roles.name: Presentation Producer
roles.accountability: Produce and verify the presentation after source conclusions are stable.
roles.boundary: Owns presentation structure, formatting, rendering, and delivery verification. Does not alter source conclusions during formatting.
acceptance_checks: The presentation covers all three levels.
The deck is verified before delivery.

scenario_bindings.responsibility_adjustment: Use delivery processing to create and verify a presentation file.
